description:
Certificate of Lawful Development to confirm the use of  No 26a High Street as 1 residential flat (at rear ground and first floor level) and No 28a High Street as 2 residential flats - flat 1 at rear ground floor and flat 2 at rear first floor level 
(Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for a Existing Development).
decision_conditions: The existing use does not require planning permission by reason of Section(s) (enter other sec no's) 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990: Section 191 as amended by section 10 of the Planning Compensation Act 1991, as the Applicant has been able to demonstrate that the use described as the Description of the Development has been in existence and has been constantly used as such for a period of at least four
years prior to the date of this application.
